item.title: Economic Survey 2026: How government put road & rail infra expansion on fast track
item.description: On National Highways, the survey says the network has grown 60% in 12 years.

item.title: Economic Survey 2026: How better regulation is building confidence in India’s capital markets
item.description: IMF and World Bank data shows India’s capital markets expanded from 144% of GDP in 2017 to 175% in 2024. During the same period, total financial sector assets rose to nearly 187% of GDP

item.title: Dixon Technologies reports 68% rise in Q3 net profit, revenue at Rs 10,671 crore
item.description: Q3 earnings: Revenue climbed 2% to Rs 10,671 crore in the last quarter against Rs 10,454 crore a year ago.

item.title: Gold scales fresh record near $5,600 on geopolitics, weak US outlook; what lies ahead
item.description: Bullion has gained more than 27% this year, driven by US policy uncertainty, expectations of Federal Reserve rate cuts, a sharply weaker dollar and intensifying geopolitical risks. In India, gold futures crossed Rs 1,75,000 per 10 grams for the first time and extended gains beyond Rs 1,80,000.

item.title: Sunetra 'vahini' to be Maharashtra Dy CM? NCP set to propose her name, may meet Fadnavis soon
item.description: Maharashtra politics latest: Ajit Pawar and four others passed away on Wednesday after an aircraft crashed 200 metres from the edge of the Baramati airstrip.

item.title: Vedanta Q3 earnings: Net profit surges 60% at Rs 5,710 crore; revenue jumps 37%
item.description: The company’s revenue from operations climbed 37 per cent to Rs 23,369 crore against Rs 17,063 crore in the year-ago period.

item.title: Economic Survey flags power, water, GPU bottlenecks as India targets 4GW data centre capacity
item.description: The Economic Survey said India must be careful about expanding AI infrastructure, as power, finance and especially water remain limited.

item.title: Ahead of Budget 2026: Why US investors do not see Indian stocks as compelling buy
item.description: Emkay Global said the skepticism around earnings recovery stems from periodic failures of a turnaround in FY25 and FY26, given continued downgrades to the consensus’s earnings estimates.
